_comment: Non-secret config for the DYNGW v2 ADMIN console proxy. Two pages: index.html (registry
entry screen + dashboard) and report.html (the linkage report across Registry, CallLog,
CallStep and RegistryHistory). Both reach SAP through the dynamic gateway v2 only
(ZFS_SB_DYNGW_O4_API), and deliberately read the four entity sets DIRECTLY rather than
through RunQuery -- a RunQuery would write a CallLog row into the very tables this console
No password here: it is read from the environment variable named below, falling back to the
gitignored .claude/settings.local.json 'env' block at the repo root (same value the MCP
The 'services' block is deliberately IDENTICAL across every console under web/: each proxy
exposes all five services at /api/ottk/*, /api/dttk/*, /api/dealid/*, /api/tf/* and
/api/dyngw/*, so a page can reach any of them without its console being re-wired first. A
console using only some of them is normal -- an unused route costs nothing (no session is
opened until the first call to that key).
Port 8774 keeps this server clear of every console under web/individual/ (8765-8772) and of
